text:
amelia: Quick sync  opened a small PR to adjust the quotas page: add an example for tiered billing, update the Grafana panel link, and include an SDK snippet for reading quota headers. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8033

tom: Nice. Two quick asks: 1) can the SDK snippet show how to fall back when unit is missing (e.g., "500" vs "500/min")? 2) Which billing metric should we call out on the dashboard image?

amelia: For #1 I added a short helper that extracts digits and normalizes to per-minute if no unit present. For #2 I pointed to the rolling "tokens_per_minute" panel and the "burst_credit_balance" series. docs-bot flagged the old grafana URL as 404.

docs-bot: Link check: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/old/quotas returned 404. Suggested replacement: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/new/quotas-overview

billing: Thanks for linking the metrics. One tiny wording request: clarify that pricing tiers are billed monthly by customer_id and that usage rollups may differ from per-key dashboards. Suggested sentence left in PR comment.

amelia: Good catch; I added that line under the "Billing & tiers" section and included an example query showing how to group by customer_id in the Metrics UI: `sum(tokens) by (customer_id)` with a 1m window.

devrel: Can we also add a short migration note for customers moving from v1 SDKs? Many folks hit 429s because they didn't respect burst credits. A one-paragraph note with the retry guidance and sample backoff code would help.

amelia: Done  added "Handling 429s: use retry-after when present, cap retries using quota header, and prefer exponential backoff with jitter" plus a 6-line python snippet.

tom: I'll review the snippet and add a unit test to the python client repo to mirror the fallback semantics. After that I'm happy to sign off. Also will update the JS example to show both header names (legacy + canonical).

amelia: Plan: merge after tom's test and a quick docs proofread. I'll also attach a new screenshot for the Grafana panel. Targeting release notes under "Usage & Quotas" for the next minor.

billing: One more request: add a short sentence about invoice timing when customers cross tiers mid-cycle. Left suggested copy in PR review.

amelia: Added it. Thanks! Leaving a final comment with the merge checklist and updated panel URL.

devrel: :rocket: small but useful. Will amplify in the changelog blurb.
